answer: A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the bridge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
